install: set -euo pipefail; if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository 2>/dev/null || echo false)" = "true" ]; then git fetch --unshallow; fi; git config core.hooksPath method/hooks; python3 method/stats.py >/dev/null; python3 method/ledger.py --selftest >/dev/null; missing=""; for t in hyperfine parallel ctags innoextract 7z msiextract llvm-undname-18 llvm-readobj-18 lld-link wine; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing $t"; done; if [ -n "$missing" ] && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then if timeout 2 getent hosts us-central1.gce.archive.ubuntu.com >/dev/null 2>&1 || timeout 2 getent hosts archive.ubuntu.com >/dev/null 2>&1; then SUDO=""; command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && SUDO="sudo"; $SUDO apt-get update -qq && $SUDO DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq hyperfine parallel universal-ctags sqlite3 innoextract p7zip-full msitools llvm llvm-18 lld lld-18 wine; else echo "WARN: apt-get repos unreachable; skipped system packages:$missing" >&2; fi; fi; V="$HOME/.cache/rom-ana"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache"; [ -x "$V/bin/python" ] || python3 -m venv "$V"; want=$(sha256sum toolchain/analysis/requirements.txt | cut -d' ' -f1); need_ana=0; [ "$(cat "$V/.req-sha" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$want" ] || need_ana=1; need_sim=0; python3 -c "import jsonschema" >/dev/null 2>&1 || need_sim=1; if [ "$need_ana" = 1 ] || [ "$need_sim" = 1 ]; then if timeout 2 getent hosts pypi.org >/dev/null 2>&1; then [ "$need_ana" = 1 ] && "$V/bin/pip" install -q --no-input -r toolchain/analysis/requirements.txt && echo "$want" > "$V/.req-sha"; [ "$need_sim" = 1 ] && pip install -q --no-input -r simulation/requirements.txt; else echo "WARN: pypi.org unreachable; skipped Python package installs" >&2; fi; fi
